projectDescription: The official primary reference for the Rust programming language, covering syntax, semantics, types, memory model, unsafety, and all language constructs in formal detail.
keyFeatures: Comprehensive formal specification of Rust language syntax and semantics
Detailed type system coverage: primitives, compound types, trait objects, generics, lifetimes
Full items reference: functions, structs, enums, unions, traits, implementations, modules
Expression and statement reference with operator semantics and precedence
Pattern matching specification including destructuring and match ergonomics
Macro system: declarative macros-by-example and procedural macros
Attribute reference: testing, derive, diagnostics, code generation, type system
Name resolution, namespaces, scopes, paths, and visibility rules
Memory model, variable lifetimes, destructors, and interior mutability
Unsafety model: undefined behavior, raw pointers, unsafe traits, and FFI
Conditional compilation and the cfg system
publicApiSurface: Lexical tokens: keywords, identifiers, literals, punctuation
Item declarations: fn, struct, enum, union, trait, impl, mod, use, extern crate, static, const, type
Expression forms: block, operator, closure, loop, match, if/else, async/await, return
Pattern kinds: literal, identifier, wildcard, range, reference, struct, tuple, slice, or-patterns
Type kinds: bool, numeric, char, str, never, tuple, array, slice, struct, enum, union, fn item, closure, pointer, fn pointer, trait object, impl trait, type parameter
Macro invocation syntax and macro_rules! pattern matching
Procedural macro types: function-like, derive, attribute
Visibility modifiers: pub, pub(crate), pub(super), pub(in path)
unsafe keyword usage: blocks, functions, traits, impl, extern
Constant evaluation: const fn, const blocks, static initializers
